memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild imbalance when turning head quickly; denies difficulty with ADLs.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal); negative screen.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds; fall risk low.
medicines: 0 regular; no polypharmacy.
mood: denies low mood or anxiety; sleep adequate.
carers: Priya Sharma, spouse.
goals: "I want to stay independent and continue working without dizziness."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg twice daily
meclizine 25 mg as needed for vertigo

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Pure tone audiometry (both ears): thresholds within normal limits (0-25 dB HL) 250-8000 Hz; no conductive or sensorineural loss.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dix-Hallpike test: right posterior canal positive; vertigo and torsional nystagmus elicited; consistent with benign positional vertigo.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:

cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated (annual schedule pending).

medicines: betahistine 16 mg BD, meclizine 25 mg SOS; 2 regular; no polypharmacy.
mood: reports mild frustration with episodes; otherwise stable.
carers: Priya Sharma, spouse.
goals: "I want to stay independent and continue working without dizziness."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to ENT specialist for evaluation of recurrent positional vertigo despite medical therapy; request vestibular function testing and possible repositioning maneuvers.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: ENT assessment: Dix-Hallpike positive left posterior canal; performed Epley maneuver; symptoms resolved. Advised continuation of betahistine and meclizine SOS; return in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Audiometry repeat: thresholds within normal limits (0-25 dB HL); no change from baseline; hearing stable.
